name: 43591-imageprefill-gemma3-4b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine (`--distributed-executor-backend uni`), no worker processes.
load_profile: Poisson, rate = 7 req/s, warmup 20%, bounded at 250 requests. The warmup resolves to 50 requests, but the scored count is what the run itself reports and is not `250 - 50`. `safety_seconds: 900` is a runaway guard, not a bound: at 7 req/s the bound is ~36 s of arrivals.
workload: Single-turn image prefill, two images per request: 128 prompt tokens of synthetic text plus two 896x896 JPEG noise images (quality 85, seeds 43591 and 143591), and exactly 4 output tokens with EOS ignored. Each image reaches the decoder as 256 tokens, so a request is ~655 tokens in and 4 out once the chat template is applied. The two seeds must differ and the two `synthetic_image` sources must stay separate -- a single source with `images_per_request: 2` silently builds a two-turn, one-image-per-turn conversation instead, and errors nowhere.
purpose: A visual question answering service for two-image uploads with short prompts and brief replies, at seven requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine command line for commit 5274c1181dc61bdf6e5eb610d37ebef694b1340d. The interpreter
# that runs it and the hardware seal live in configs/env.yaml, which is not portable.

# HAZARD: `google/gemma-3-4b-it` is gated and this machine holds no token for it. This is
# the standard ungated mirror of the same weights -- a substitution of REPOSITORY, not model.
model: unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it
trust-remote-code: true
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192

# LOAD-BEARING, do not delete it as "the default": the engine default at this commit is 2048,
# which admits about three prefills per step here against about a dozen -- a different
# operating point.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# Must match the number of image sources in scenario.json: it is both the admission limit and
# what the engine's startup profiling pass is sized against. Change one and change the other.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 2, "video": 0}

enable-prefix-caching: false
distributed-executor-backend: uni
tensor-parallel-size: 1
